items.q: Which enzyme cuts DNA at specific base sequences?
items.qAf: Watter ensiem sny DNS by spesifieke basisvolgordes?
items.explain: Restriction endonucleases recognise and cut specific DNA sequences.
items.explainAf: Restriksie-endonukleases herken en sny spesifieke DNS-volgordes.

items.q: Which enzyme joins DNA fragments together?
items.qAf: Watter ensiem voeg DNS-fragmente aan mekaar?
items.explain: DNA ligase seals the sugar-phosphate backbone between fragments.
items.explainAf: DNS-ligase sluit die suiker-fosfaatrugstring tussen fragmente.

items.q: Gel electrophoresis separates DNA fragments mainly according to:
items.explain: Smaller fragments move further through the gel, so fragments are separated by size.
items.explainAf: Kleiner fragmente beweeg verder deur die gel, dus word fragmente volgens grootte geskei.

items.q: In DNA profiling, which regions of DNA are usually compared?
items.qAf: Watter streke van DNS word gewoonlik in DNS-profilering vergelyk?
options: Mitochondrial DNA only in every case
optionsAf: Mitochondrial DNA only in every case
items.explain: Non-coding short tandem repeats differ greatly between people, so they are useful for profiling.
items.explainAf: Nie-kodeerende kort tandemherhalings verskil baie tussen mense, dus is hulle nuttig vir profilering.

items.q: How is the hormone rBST produced for use in dairy cows?
items.qAf: Hoe word die hormoon rBST geproduseer vir gebruik in melkkoeie?
options: By genetically modified bacteria that make the hormone
By injecting cows with pituitary tissue from other cows
optionsAf: By genetically modified bacteria that make the hormone
By injecting cows with pituitary tissue from other cows
items.explain: The bovine growth gene is inserted into bacteria, which then produce the hormone in large amounts.
items.explainAf: Die beesgroeigeen word in bakterieë ingevoeg, wat dan die hormoon in groot hoeveelhede maak.

items.q: Why can DNA profiling not tell apart identical twins?
items.qAf: Waarom kan DNS-profilering nie identiese tweelinge onderskei nie?
options: Identical twins share the same DNA
Identical twins have different sex chromosomes
DNA profiling does not work on children
optionsAf: Identical twins share the same DNA
Identical twins have different sex chromosomes
DNA profiling does not work on children
items.explain: Identical twins develop from one zygote and so have identical DNA.
items.explainAf: Identiese tweelinge ontwikkel uit een sigoot en het dus identiese DNS.
